description:

review MERGE, no blocking finding -- three observations widened into
fz-kdt.112's hazard record).

THE FIX: every raw-Ty-id (and duplicate) sort key in artifact PACKAGING
replaced by the fz-kdt.105 canonical comparator through one chokepoint
(jobs/artifact::compare_executable_symbols): 13 sites fixed/folded --
compare_executable_keys, 5 backend packaging sorts, codegen seam facts,
transport_executable_sort_key DELETED, transport's byte-for-byte
duplicate symbol key + raw callable_direct_edge key folded,
compare_executable_needs 3 encodings -> 1, sort_by_cached_key -> sort_by
(stale caching comment rewritten). Left with recorded reasons: FunctionId
leading components (structurally safe for executables -- canon keys
embed labels; wrapper cross-function corner recorded in fz-kdt.112),
ShapeId/CallableId/BoundaryId mint-order sorts (fz-kdt.112, unproven
leaks), semantic-layer OrderedSets (load-bearing determinism), canon's
rendered-text sorts (tie fallback now DOCUMENTED load-bearing on this
fix). Key detail: canon re-sorts on id-free rendered keys but ties fall
to PUBLISHED order -- which is why only byte-identical twins (the w10/w11
wrappers) ever leaked; published order is now the injective structural
order, closing the loop non-circularly (refuter-verified).

RED-FIRST (both re-verified red by comparator-revert at HEAD -- genuine
regression gates): canon_test sibling-order (20 sibling pairs in
interning order at base, verbatim) + transport_contract_test wrapper-tie
(31 vs 0). LIFO recipes in the doc comments.

RESULTS: 00420/00183/range_map canon BYTE-IDENTICAL FIFO vs LIFO (base
had the 4-line w10/w11 swap -- fz-kdt.101's original observable, gone);
predicate residual = exactly fz-kdt.106's 14 keys, ZERO renumbering
lines; 00277's pre-existing gap identical base/head (recorded in 106).
canon-gate at FIFO: 8/8/6 changed lines, ALL construction=wN
renumbering, normalized multisets identical, key sets equal, executables
207/59/217 and wrappers 46/8/36 unchanged, pins untouched. Behavior
byte-identical 5 fixtures x interp+JIT (incl. 00277's known fz-kdt.111
rc=1 abort, identical both sides). No positional consumer of any
re-sorted list exists (refuter traced every consumer: set-wise only;
wrapper member targets remapped through the sorted inventory's own index
-- consistent by construction). Fresh gate on merged HEAD: lib 1527/0,
cli 23/0, matrix 425/0, clippy -D warnings, fmt clean.
